name: Genesis 1:1–2:4a (Priestly creation account)

surviving_manuscript_date.note: Physical-witness dating is left unassigned in this seed rather than conflated with composition.

estimated_composition.method: Broad exilic/post-exilic range representing a common critical dating of Priestly composition/editing while preserving live debate about earlier dating.

tradition_internal_claim.note: Narrates primordial creation without a historical calendar date.

estimated_oral_origin.method: No specific oral-origin date is defensible for this literary account.

dating.dating_summary: Widely identified as Priestly material; this seed uses a broad disputed sixth-to-fifth-century BCE composition range rather than a point date.

notes: Modeled separately from Genesis 2:4b–3:24 because critical scholarship widely treats them as distinct creation accounts.
